_note: 主题预设：一份数据，零代码新增主题。新增一个节日只需往 themes 里加一条。
🔴 提示词**不能写死具体文案**：底板资源每张的文字都不一样（8-DAY / 50x Rebate / …）。
早期版本把「8-DAY」「Login Premium Gift」写进 prompt，换一张图就会把旧文案画上去。
现在改为模板拼装：layout（构图锁，通用规则或 --layout 传入）+ theme 字段（配色/装饰/服装/空区）。
themes 字段语义：
zh/en       中文名 / 英文主题名（进 prompt）
suffix      产出文件名后缀
palette     配色（给人看的，也打印在环节日志里）
decoration  装饰元素（给人看的）
text_style  原文字的材质/描边处理（只改材质，不改字）
outfit      角色服装改成什么样（姿势/位置/缩放不许动）
body        大片空白卡体（给 UI 覆盖层用）换成什么质感
banner      顶部横幅底色
decor_sentence 替换掉原装饰的句子
providers: manual=人/Agent 出图后丢进 inbox；chatgpt_web=浏览器 cookie 驱动 chatgpt.com；
任何能写文件的模型都可以用 manual 接入，本文件不绑定具体厂商。
body_colors: 长条底板（banner + 大片空白区）的续接渐变两端色，postprocess --hero-band 用。
composition（构图自由度，--composition 或 COMPOSITION=）：三档，放开的东西严格递增。
lock=人物姿势/位置/缩放全锁，只换衣服与配色（默认，可预期）；
free=允许重设计人物姿势与镜头换吸引力，但**仍然锁死**文案完整可读、底部 UI 空白区、画布比例与透明边；
design=AI 自主设计整张图（版面/场景/镜头/道具/装饰全放开，只要像这款游戏的画法、更抓眼），
只锁四件硬边界：画风一致、画布比例与安全边、文案策略（无字不许造字）、UI 功能空区。
free 用 layout_free，lock 用 layout_default，design 用 layout_design；主题可用 pose_hints 给 free 模式候选姿势。
🔴 layout_design 是 design 档唯一的护栏：删掉任何一条都等于把 UI 契约也放开了（themes --check 会拦）。
🔴 design 档默认**不注入** pose_hint（姿势归模型自主决定），只有显式 --pose 才注入；free 档仍走随机池。
🔴 pose_hints 必须是「数组 + 手里不拿新道具」：早期写死成 pose_hint 单条且指定『递出一个礼盒』，
结果每张 free 图都变成同一个抱礼物姿势（不是随机，是硬编码）。现在每次随机抽一条，--pose N 可指定，--pose none 关掉。
主题分档（画法/参数配方）与批量出图见 docs/art_restyle_themes.md；新增主题跑 `restyle_pipeline.py themes --check` 自检后再用。
现役主题：christmas / newyear / halloween / valentine / summer_surf / provence / thanksgiving / cyber（名字→文件名后缀用 suffix 字段）。
候选句一律用空手/动作表达吸引力（撩发、扶帽、回身、甩披风…），要拿道具只能拿原图本来就有的那个。
layout_default: 1) Every existing piece of text (headline, numerals, captions, badges, ribbons) keeps the EXACT same wording, spelling, position, scale and weight as the input image. Only its color/material may shift to the new palette. Do NOT add, remove, reword or re-typeset any text.
2) The illustrated character keeps the same pose, position, scale and silhouette; only the outfit, accessories and small props are restyled.
3) The large empty body area reserved for UI overlays stays empty with the same shape and margins - no text, no clutter, no ornaments in the center.
4) Keep the original canvas aspect ratio, framing, bleed and rounded-corner silhouettes.
layout_design: 1) DESIGN FREEDOM - you are the art director: re-invent the layout, the scene, the camera, the staging, the props and the decorative framing. Do NOT trace the input layout for safety. Design the strongest, most appealing version of this panel - the kind of key art that stops a player mid-scroll - and make it read instantly as the same game.

2) HARD LIMIT - ART DIRECTION: it must look painted by the same artist as the input image and hang next to the game's other panels without clashing: same lineart weight and line colour, same flat two-tone cel shading, same level of detail, same face / eye / hair rendering, same prop and ornament design language. No painterly brushwork, no 3D or CGI, no photoreal, no western cartoon, no mixed styles.

3) HARD LIMIT - CANVAS: keep the EXACT aspect ratio of the input image (a wide horizontal banner stays a wide horizontal banner). Every important element - face, hands, focal prop, decorations that must be seen - stays fully inside a five-percent safe margin, nothing clipped by an edge. Add no border, frame, letterbox or outer glow.

4) HARD LIMIT - HANDS: hands are where AI art fails, so build them deliberately. Every visible hand must read as a real hand at a glance: one palm, one thumb, exactly four fingers, five digits in total, knuckles bending the right way, digits attached to a visible palm, correct foreshortening - no extra, missing, fused or floating digit, no finger-length noodle strands hanging off a cuff, no wrist or sleeve forking into two limbs. Short simple nails. Keep each hand at least a hand-width inside the canvas: a hand sliced off by the frame edge reads as a bug, and never splay the fingers straight at the camera. Safest staging - the hand rests on, grips or leans against something already in the picture (the trophy rim, a gift box, a bauble): contact with an object is what makes hand anatomy come out right. Anatomy checklist to build every hand from: digits graded by length - middle finger longest, then index and ring, pinky clearly shortest (equal little sausages read as a bug); the thumb springs from the base of the palm and touches it along its whole base, never a detached wedge floating beside the palm with a gap; a wrist joins the hand to the cuff and is narrower than the palm, never fingers sprouting straight out of a fur cuff; palm width believable and the whole hand smaller than her face. If a raised open hand is really wanted, turn it three-quarter away from the camera with the fingers held together and softly curled - a flat palm fanned square at the viewer is the single worst case and is not allowed.

5) HARD LIMIT - TEXT: draw NO lettering, numerals, labels, badges, signage, logos, signatures or watermarks. If (and only if) the input image already contains text, keep that text verbatim in the same reading order, complete and razor-sharp, and restyle its material only.

6) HARD LIMIT - UI FUNCTION: any area the input reserves for UI overlays (blank plate, bottom band, side column, dead space behind buttons) keeps its position, size and margins and stays calm and low contrast - no busy detail, no bright ornament, no high-frequency texture there, and never put the face, hands or a focal prop in front of it.

7) COMPOSITION CRAFT: one clear focal point; the character carries the strongest value contrast; staged depth (foreground ornament - mid character - background scene) with air around the subject. No flat wall of decoration, no ornament colliding with her silhouette.
layout_free: 1) Every piece of text keeps the EXACT same wording, spelling and language as the input image - no added, removed or reworded words, and every glyph must stay complete, sharp and fully readable. You may re-position or re-scale the text block for a better composition, but it must stay in the upper banner area, inside the canvas and inside the safe margins (nothing clipped at the edges, nothing hidden behind the character).
2) The character may be completely re-posed and re-framed (see CHARACTER), but her face must stay clearly visible and must never cover the text.
3) The large empty body area reserved for UI overlays stays empty with the same shape and margins - no text, no character parts, no clutter, no ornaments in the center of the panel.
4) Keep the original canvas aspect ratio, the same bleed and the same rounded-corner / card silhouettes; every transparent region stays transparent.

explore.notes: 「探索/寻宝」不是节日，是场景题材，靠 decor_sentence 换世界（霓虹基地→古遗迹），不靠换节日装饰。石绿+黄铜是主色，角色容易跟背景糊在一起，需要时 FRAME_RIM 用 warm 拉开明度。图里有透明上沿时，alpha 走 source 掩膜，别让模型自己画边。
